svg.text: NC265 FORCE-PIGTAIL STRAIN PROTOTYPE — RECEIVING REQUIREMENTS
149×39 PCB • u→X172+u, v→Z3.5+v, normal w→Y180.5−w • dimensions mm
No full-unit fit, material, insulation compression, thread, pull, creep, torque or fabrication approval.
35 overall u (58..93)
Post OD6.0 nominal
OD6.1 receiving max
Post w0..5.0
Lower bridge w4.8..13
Post-to-cap gap0.3
MATCHED WIRE / HARDWARE DATUMS
Channel centres u68,73,79,84 / v21. Prototype Ø1.65; match EACH measured wire to OD−0.05 trial.
Nominal wire Ø1.70; ±0.01 measurement / ±0.02 machining imply 0.02..0.08 diametric trial compression.
This is a bench starting point. MPPE damage/grip/creep/hot pull and allowed load profile remain unknown.
PCB anchors (61,21)/(90,21): NPTH nominalØ2.6 / finished MINØ2.5; all6Cu layers R3.7 exclusion.
Force holes: nominalØ2.2 / finished MINØ2.1 / Ø3.8 land. Gauge Ø1.4 bare +0.3 centre +0.005 reserve.
Material: MCAM Ketron1000 natural unfilled PEEK. Datasheet properties are indicative, not guaranteed allowables.
Mount: Accu SPP-M2-5-A2 + HPW-M2-A2-BL. Cap: SPP-M2-6-A2 + same washer. M2×0.4 tapped PEEK.
Base tap pilotsØ1.6: mount depth4.1; cap depth3.0. STEP shows pilot holes; actual thread process unqualified.
Nominal thread overlaps3.05 /2.15. Incoming length±0.1 is a project requirement, not catalog guarantee.
Rear head+washer reaches w−3.83 max (worldY184.33); distinct from the 1.5 rear lead policy.
Cap head+washer maxv26.57 (worldZ30.07). Local post/solder clearance tested at maxOD6.1 +0.45 margin.
Whole PCB uses actual components/layout and supports separately. Solder joints are NOT strain anchors.
Review drawing: module geometry.scad and pilot-hole STEP are authoritative candidate sources; no scale-from-screen manufacturing.
